request.title: Port P0244: 48 ready modules to Lean 4.36 (5 fixed, 43 unchanged)
request.body:
Refs #32669 (packet claim, kept open: this is a **partial** packet submission and P0244 remains incomplete).

Ports the 48 ready members of P0244 to the target in `port/target.json`:
- Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0` (`Lean (version 4.36.0, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, commit 611c117bfaf7b7ae1cfcf246ce6fba31e8f509e9, Release)`)
- Mathlib `fc4f59e577feb1a4956671bc04ac18aaaf8cd842`

5 modules patched, 43 unchanged. The only statement change is to the private helper in M032080 (`MvPolynomial.coeff` argument form), with a notes entry arguing equivalence. Nothing touches `Main`, `Statements` or the public theorems.

## Commands run and results

1. `python3 tracker/port_build.py prepare WORK`: archive parts downloaded from alpo.ge and verified; `elan toolchain install` is blocked in this sandbox, so the toolchain was installed from the official `lean-4.36.0-linux.zip` GitHub release asset into `WORK/elan`, and the remaining prepare steps (`lake update`, `lake exe cache get`) were run by hand with the same environment.
2. `python3 tracker/port_build.py check P0244 WORK --ready-only`: the first run was cut off by a session time limit while building the 43rd module; of the 42 finished, 38 built unchanged and M030864, M031267, M032080, M033044 failed. No reused-name warnings.
3. Fixed them in `WORK/lean/src`; second `check P0244 WORK --ready-only`: 46 of 48 (M031267 needed explicit arguments; M033460 hit the heartbeat limit). After those two fixes, `lake --no-cache build +<Module>:olean` succeeded for both.
4. `lake env lean --run port/reused_audit.lean <48 modules>`: `reused-audit: 48 module(s), 0 hit(s)`; `port/islattice_audit.lean`: `islattice-audit: 48 module(s), 0 hit(s)`.
5. `python3 tracker/port_build.py diff P0244 WORK`, then `reproduce P0244 WORK OUT --ready-only --issue 32669`: all 14 parts match `parts.sha256`, all 48 packet and 153 import source hashes match, fresh tree with `lake --no-cache build +<Module>:olean` per module, every module `exit=0`, ending `== done: 48 of 48 modules built`.
6. `records P0244 WORK --ready-only --evidence <receipt URL> --notes notes.json`; after rebasing on current `main`, `python3 tracker/validate_ports.py`: `Validated 15748 port records.` Added lines contain no `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`/`implemented_by`/`native_decide`/`unsafe`.
